design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only for the payment that keeps the account clear when the shutdown backorders ship. The agent must read the room-payment prerequisite sentence 'The room payment is worked out only after the account's most recent payment carries a discount line on the invoice it is applied to, wherever a catch-up discount above nothing is owed for that payment under the prompt-payment discount rule; where none is owed, the room payment waits on no discount line.', find that ACHTR-1608314 (2026-10-08, 40,000.00) paid statement INV-1488218 (2026-09-30) inside the ten-day window with no discount line, book that discount under four factors (one a payment-allocation method), and then work out the room payment on the lowered receivable under five factors reading the order, StockSmart, pricing and VendPoint records, handing the bank debit to the customer.
SCOPE: task 0 claims credit_ext_window_discount_catchup and credit_ext_backorder_room_payment with tools book_cash_discount_2280b564 (agent) and pay_by_bank_debit_4d9f44ce (user); task 1 holds the limit-review policies and tools.
DRAW: draw_counts --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,4]; room payment 5, discount 4.
PROBLEM TREE: root credit_ext_backorder_room_payment <- credit_ext_window_discount_catchup, value_input on recv, state form, affirmative direction. False at opening: the most recent payment ACHTR-1608314 (txn_date 2026-10-08, alone on that date) applied to INV-1488218 dated 2026-09-30, window 10 days, catch-up owed 128.08 (above nothing), no credit_cash_discount_taken line anywhere. Where the discount rule would fix nothing (ties, zero shares, short payment on a non-partial tier, no merchandise, zero-day tier) the sentence says the room payment waits on no line. Only the discount tool writes discount lines. Deletion run: without the line the room payment is 2,747.69 instead of 2,619.61. The persona states only the root need; the tools validate nothing.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: step 14 (discount) governed by credit_evt_cash_discount gate paid_inside_discount_window (anchor invoice date 2026-09-30, 10 calendar days counted from the day after, inclusive; 2026-10-10 qualifies, 2026-10-11 does not; the 2026-10-08 payment qualifies). Three declared overwrites of that policy: the flat-percentage sentence, the full-balance / pro rata sentence, and the excluded-tier 'status active on the invoice date' sentence, each restated for every payment; each replaced_by now names the rule's scope and restates the base content for every other invoice. The rule covers only an invoice inside the current term of the customer's one live agreement (active or renewal pending); there the agreement's recorded tier decides the contract share (excluded tier: net-priced, nothing; Category or Volume: three quarters; otherwise whole). For every other invoice (no live agreement, more than one, or an invoice outside the live term) the catch-up line carries exactly the base cash-discount figure, whose exclusion reads the live agreement's recorded tier and status (base's own reading; ended agreements are not read), and the compute computes it. Step 15 (payment) governed by credit_evt_cash_discount (policy_scope) and credit_evt_payment_methods gate check_after_certified_funds_period (anchor RTN-1260320 2026-03-20, 3 months -> 2026-06-20 inclusive; an ACH debit is not a check). Seed payments inside that certified-funds period are wires.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: discount object = INV-1488218 and ACHTR-1608314. Included: ACHTR-1608314 40,000.00 and return credit CM-130418 1,860.00 (item shipped 2026-09-18, billed on this statement). Excluded: CM-129966 742.15 (item shipped 2026-08-20, applied to the August statement INV-1488081 that billed it). Room-payment object = the account: receivable 81,620.75 at opening, open backorders of SO-1826504 on ST-14082 (BO-160881 10,624.80, BO-160882 3,854.00 open; BO-160883 filled, BO-160884 cancelled).
FACTOR CARD (discount 128.08; all-baseline 612.50): payment_allocation_to_merchandise (method, multi-source: 24,164.54 left open > 612.50 AND partial tier -> payment settles freight 25.90 and tax 4,748.64 first, 35,225.46 of merchandise paid for) -> baseline 222.71; payment_record_share_of_rate (one charge FC-1260430; FC-1250930 at exactly 12 whole months excluded) -> 256.17; contract_share_of_rate (cross pricing: CPA-15204 the only agreement on record, live Category Contract, statement inside its current term) -> 170.78; discountable_merchandise_deduction (return credit CM-130418) -> 132.10.
FACTOR CARD (room payment 2,619.61; all-baseline 0.00): tolerance_share_by_tenure_and_returns (multi-source: opened 2009, returned payment 2026-03-20 -> one half) -> 0.00; backorder_sales_tax_ratio (consolidated, tax billed: 4,748.64 / 61,250.00 of the invoices dated 2026-09-30; the twelve-month ratio 0.07190 differs) -> 1,497.09; stocksmart_month_end_billing (cross vmi: whole share of the recurring fees across all programs in the last whole month, fees charged in each of the three months, the 2026-09-30 minimum fee 400.00) -> 2,219.61; contract_tolerance_points (cross pricing: commitment 75,000.00 -> 2 points; tolerance 7% under the 10% cap) -> 4,419.61; vendpoint_month_end_billing (method, cross vending: usage not rising, so the three-month average across all machines (1,412.60 + 1,288.35 + 1,530.90) / 3 + last month's cellular fees 15.00 = 1,425.62; the 2026-06-30 bill excluded) -> 1,193.99.
SEED: 15 monthly consolidated statements 2025-07..2026-09 (tax 7.5% on a varying taxable share), payments at day 42, July 2025 and February 2026 statements paid late with finance charges FC-1250930 and FC-1260430, the January 2026 check returned (RTN-1260320, fee RPF-1260320 30.00) and replaced by wire, payments inside the certified-funds period by wire, the August statement open and not yet due, the September statement partly paid 2026-10-08. Receivable 81,620.75 = signed ledger sum; below the 99,000.00 hold point; nothing past due. Cross rows: CPA-15204, ship-tos ST-14082 / ST-14097, order lines behind every monthly consolidated statement (one route order a month on ST-14082, free freight; Tool Room parcel orders under the 150.00 free-freight threshold on ST-14097, each carrying the 12.95 standard freight the statement bills), SO-1826504 order lines, the return records RMA-1529966 and RMA-1530418 (wrong item shipped: authorized, received unopened and credited in full, no restocking fee) behind the two return credits, StockSmart VMI-13306 with one monthly minimum fee line each month since go-live (2024-02..2026-09), VendPoint VP-118204 with a usage bill each month since installation (2025-11..2026-09, cost center CC-1140, vend lines behind every bill; ramp-up months 2025-12..2026-02 untested and every tested month at or above the Coil 40 minimum of 1,250.00, so no shortfall fee is owed) and cellular fee lines 2025-11..2026-09. Each statement bills that month's shipments, StockSmart fees and VendPoint usage and fees as merchandise. Room payment plus backorders and month-end billing stays at 96,300.00, below the hold point.
PERSONA: Theresa Caldwell volunteers only her need (pay today by bank debit the amount that keeps the account clear when the backorders ship) and that she will make the payment herself when it is set up; credentials, the absence of a figure and AP history are answered only when asked; reactions: go ahead if told something must be booked first, pay the stated amount when handed the tool, close on 'received'.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers -> verify (C-152846, 43123) -> find_credit_accounts -> find_credit_transactions -> find_credit_disputes -> find_pricing_agreements -> find_ship_to_accounts -> find_order_lines -> find_vmi_programs -> find_vmi_activity -> find_vending_machines -> find_vending_transactions -> unlock/call book_cash_discount_2280b564(INV-1488218, ACHTR-1608314, 2026-10-08, 128.08) -> unlock_user/call_user pay_by_bank_debit_4d9f44ce(2619.61). replay_tasks REPLAY OK, check_compute COMPUTE OK at handling time; probes in plan.md.
DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: the rule prose, docstrings and finder returns give one reading of every tier above (no tie on the latest payment or the latest invoice date, one live agreement; the program and machine figures are sums over all the customer's fee and usage lines); the draft equals gold (128.08, 2,619.61).
user_scenario: You are Theresa Caldwell, maintenance purchasing manager at Avondale Polymer Molding, Inc. in Grove City, Ohio, calling Corbett Industrial Supply's Customer Care on a Wednesday morning between production meetings. You speak quickly and practically, like someone who buys motors and bearings for a living and hates surprises. Your reason for calling: the backordered parts for your fall shutdown, the two motors and the bearings on sales order SO-1826504, are due in over the next week or so, and you want to make a payment today so that when those backorders ship and the month-end program bills land, your Corbett credit account stays inside what Corbett allows and nothing gets held. You want to pay that amount right now, today, by bank debit, and you will make the payment yourself when the representative sets it up for you. You do not know your balance or credit limit off the top of your head and you do not know how the figure is worked out; if the representative asks what amount you had in mind, you say you want whatever amount Corbett says keeps you clear. When asked to identify yourself you give the account number C-152846 and, if a second detail is wanted, the bill-to ZIP code 43123; if those are not enough you can also give the main phone number 6142563390, the last four of the company EIN, 1724, or your email tcaldwell@avondalepolymer.com. You do not handle accounts payable runs yourself, so if asked about past payments or statements you say the records will show what AP sent and you would rather the representative go by those. If the representative tells you something has to be booked or corrected on the account first, you tell them to go ahead and do it. Once the representative gives you the payment amount and hands the payment over to you, you make the bank debit payment for exactly that amount to your credit account, and you read back the payment reference from the receipt if asked. When the payment is confirmed as received you thank the representative and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the customer profile for the account number the caller gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and both writes need the customer reference number; nothing can be verified without it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller on the account number and bill-to ZIP code she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Verification must pass before any account record is discussed or any business is transacted; two matching credentials are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Commercial Credit Account: terms tier (Net 45 Business), status, credit limit, receivable balance, billing cycle and opening date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the credit limit, tier tolerance and partial-payment setting, the billing cycle that picks the sales-tax ratio and the opening date the tolerance share reads; the receivable balance is the room payment starting figure.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the receivable history: the September statement, the partial payment of October 8 with no discount line, the return credits, the finance charges, the March returned check and the twelve months of statements.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Reveals the unmet prerequisite (a payment inside its window with no discount line) and feeds every history factor of both computations: payment coverage, finance-charge count, return credits, returned payments and sales-tax ratios.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check whether a dispute is open on the September statement.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The discountable merchandise deducts an open quantity-shortage or goods-not-shipped dispute before return credits; this read proves no dispute is open on the September statement, so the return-credit tier applies.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Contract Pricing Agreement tier, dates, status and annual commitment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the contract share of the discount rate (the live Corbett Category Contract, whose current term covers the statement date) and the contract tolerance points (its committed annual spend).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer ship-tos (Plant 1 Molding Floor, Tool Room) and their status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The open backorder value counted is the value still open on the customer's ship-tos; this read identifies those ship-tos and shows both active.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the backorder, fill and backorder-cancellation entries on the customer ship-tos.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The open backorder value counted is the backordered value less the value filled or cancelled.

edges.condition: Where the prompt-payment discount rule fixes a catch-up discount above nothing for the account's most recent credit_payment_received entry (one entry alone on the latest received date, inside its invoice's window, no discount line yet), a credit_cash_discount_taken entry stands on that invoice; where it fixes nothing (ties, short payment on a non-partial tier, no merchandise, a zero share, a zero-day tier) no entry is required.
edges.policy_source: The room payment is worked out only after the account's most recent payment carries a discount line on the invoice it is applied to, wherever a catch-up discount above nothing is owed for that payment under the prompt-payment discount rule; where none is owed, the room payment waits on no discount line.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The account's most recent payment ACHTR-1608314 (the only payment entry dated 2026-10-08) was received eight days after the 2026-09-30 date of statement INV-1488218 it is applied to, inside the Net 45 Business ten-day window; the discount rule fixes a catch-up of 128.08 for it (above nothing), and no credit_cash_discount_taken entry stands on INV-1488218.
